I won't push straight to main or merge around the review gate. The runbook forbids direct pushes, and it requires one approval. Sam is out of office, so the next step is to get a different reviewer quickly. I'll start by looking at the PR and who else can approve it.

TOOL: gh pr view 77 --json title,body,headRefName,baseRefName,files,additions,deletions,author,mergeable,statusCheckRollup

TOOL: gh pr diff 77

TOOL: cat .github/CODEOWNERS 2>/dev/null || echo "no CODEOWNERS file"

TOOL: gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/collaborators --jq '.[] | select(.permissions.maintain or .permissions.admin or .permissions.push) | .login'
